citationText: (b) Takayanagi started his work on a cathode-ray system in March 1926. He claimed that he had a new sync system in Sept. 1926, and by Oct. 1926 it was operating, The December 1926 date was given later. See Kenjiro Takayanagi, “Research and Development of All Electronic Television System,” p. 6 . Publicity release given the author in August 1981 during a visit with Prof. Takayanagi in Tokyo, Japan.
